item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena adds two spoons of sugar to a glass of water and stirs. After some time, no sugar grains can be seen, yet the whole glass of water tastes sweet.

Which statement best explains this?

options.A: The sugar particles spread out and occupy the spaces between the water particles, so sugar is present throughout the water.
options.B: The sugar particles melt into a liquid and float on top of the water, making it sweet.
options.C: The sugar disappears completely, and only its sweetness stays behind in the water.
options.D: Each water particle absorbs a sugar particle inside itself, which makes the water particle sweet.
